title: Epworth Sleepiness Scale
instructions: Rate each situation for your likelihood of dozing off or falling asleep, not just feeling tired.

score.missing_response_policy: report answered count; do not classify severity until all items are answered

items.text: Sitting, inactive, in a public place (e.g., meeting, theater, dinner event)
As a passenger in a car for an hour or more without a break
Lying down to rest when circumstances permit
Sitting quietly after a meal without alcohol
In a car, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic or at a light

severity_bands.label: Unlikely that you are abnormally sleepy
severity_bands.action: Monitor clinically; no abnormal daytime sleepiness suggested by score alone

severity_bands.label: Average amount of daytime sleepiness
severity_bands.action: Monitor symptoms and context; reassess if impairment or safety concerns are present

severity_bands.label: Excessive daytime sleepiness - further evaluation recommended
severity_bands.action: Consider formal sleep evaluation and review sleep, medication, and medical contributors

severity_bands.label: Excessive daytime sleepiness - strongly consider seeking medical attention
severity_bands.action: Strongly consider physician or sleep-medicine evaluation, especially with driving or occupational risk

report.heading: Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS)
report.scoring_note: Scoring: 0-7 unlikely abnormal sleepiness, 8-9 average daytime sleepiness, 10-15 excessive daytime sleepiness, 16-24 high excessive daytime sleepiness.

test_vectors.name: all_zero
test_vectors.expected_severity: Unlikely that you are abnormally sleepy

test_vectors.name: high_excessive
test_vectors.expected_severity: Excessive daytime sleepiness - strongly consider seeking medical attention
